name: jira-ticket
description: Jira ticket workspace lifecycle skill that drives the Herdr terminal multiplexer. /jira-ticket:ticket start SE-1234 opens a Herdr tab holding one orchestrator agent seeded with the ticket. /jira-ticket:ticket drive SE-1234 is the orchestrator's playbook: description audit, Jira status, on-demand agents in their own worktrees, child tickets, and a stack of draft PRs. /jira-ticket:ticket close [SE-1234] [PR#] closes out finished work: reconciles its docs, updates the Jira ticket, and tears down the worktree.
